top_signals.title: Bessent Deploys Debt Buybacks in Sign of Concern Over Yield Rise
top_signals.summary:
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent made a fresh attempt to rein-in long-term borrowing costs from multi-year highs, sending Treasury yields and the dollar down. 
Ira Jersey, Chief US Interest Rates Strategist for Bloomberg Intelligence, discusses the move. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Harvard Fund Discloses $2.2 Billion Stake in Musk’s SpaceX
top_signals.summary:
Harvard Management Co. disclosed a $2.2 billion stake in SpaceX, showing how the university’s endowment has profited from an early bet on Elon Musk’s giant rocket company.
Janet Lorin, Bloomberg News Higher Education Reporter, discusses the disclosure and what it signals for other university investments. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Cantor Becomes To Offer Access To Prediction Market Kalshi
top_signals.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald & Co. is giving Wall Street clients access to Kalshi’s prediction markets, in the latest push by the event bets exchange to encourage more institutional involvement in the burgeoning asset class.
